metadata.llm_reason: IDF Lookup is a distinct micro-skill that isolates the computation/retrieval of inverse document frequency values. While peer candidates (TF-IDF Weight Calculation, TF-IDF Term Weighting) consume IDF as input, this skill focuses specifically on the IDF component in isolation—retrieving corpus statistics, computing document frequency, and applying logarithmic scaling. This separation enables reuse across multiple weighting schemes and supports caching strategies. No redundancy detected with peers; supported by corpus evidence.
